Europe's gold ETFs just had their strongest month on record: net inflows hit $7.9 billion in August, the World Gold Council reports.

Global funds pulled in $18 billion, lifting worldwide holdings to a record 4,189 tonnes.

Europa's goud-ETF's kenden in augustus hun sterkste maand ooit: 7,9 miljard dollar aan instroom, meldt de World Gold Council.

Gold held at €121.11 a gram and silver at €1,824.69 a kilogram this week, the tape's verified close unchanged since 9 September.

Kitco spot and the ECB's EUR/USD reference rate of 1.1652 set the board; RapNet's one-carat benchmark still marks $3,902.20, last moved on 7 September.

Goud bleef deze week op €121,11 per gram en zilver op €1.824,69 per kilogram, ongewijzigd sinds de geverifieerde slotkoers van 9 september.
